profile.Name: Bop
profile.Personality: Nervous, eager, and odd. He claims to be a Skeleton, and when he wins a fight he boasts that he is the strongest warrior.
profile.Backstory: Hive worker who wants to become a swordsman. He lives in the northern village of the Midland Hive in Dreg. He has no weapon and no skills, which the Hive frowns on, and he wants to grow strong and learn the sword.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Blurts "Bop!" whenever he is nervous and speaks of himself as Bop when he boasts. Takes figures of speech literally.
